notes.title: Major Content Update – New Biomes, UI, Leaderboards & More
notes.content:
Biggest update yet, and I’m super excited to finally share it with you all! This one changes a lot, so please let me know if you run into any bugs! I’ll be working quickly to squash anything you find, so don’t hesitate to drop feedback in the comments.
[hr][/hr]✨ New Features
Leaderboards – Compete on every difficulty setting.

Day & Night Cycle – Time now flows naturally as you search.

Torch at Night – Keep exploring after dark with a trusty torch.

Complete UI Overhaul – Fresh look across menus and gameplay.

New Biomes – Explore the forest, pine forest, mushroom biome, plains, and flower field.

Player Poop Skill 💩 – Yes, you can poop now.

Clean Mode – For those who prefer less suggestive gameplay. Ex. "Finding Richard"

Graphics Toggle – Switch between high and low settings.

Secrets & Surprises – A few hidden things for you to discover.

Bees 🐝 – Watch out…

Ultrawide Support – Play on wider screens with proper formatting.

Credits Menu – A place to see the amazing folks behind the game.

Tips Menu – Review power-up abilities anytime.

New Achievements – Several fresh challenges await.

Rock Hard Achievement – Removed… and replaced with something significantly harder.

General Improvements – Performance, visuals, and a lot of under-the-hood tweaks.

Much, much more…
[hr][/hr]🙏 Special Thanks
To my wife – Once again, she’s behind the art that makes the game look as good as it does. Couldn’t do this without her. ❤️

To my testers – Huge thanks for all the help!
[hr][/hr]🔮 Coming Soon
New Wiener Lore – More story, more mystery, and more reasons to stretch your limits…

;)

notes.title: Fire and Relics: The Ultimate Overhaul Update
notes.content:
We are excited to announce our latest update, packed with new features and improvements!

Update Highlights
- Unlockable skills 
- New cosmetic relics
- New relics, power-ups, and debuffs
- Airdrops
- UI overhaul
- Fire
- Wiener dog redesigned
- New achievements
- Performance increases
- Secret relic


Content
- New cosmetic: Prince Albert's Crown for your wiener
- New cosmetic: Sunglasses for the sun
- New debuff: Blue Balls, sends the player flying in a random direction.
- New debuff: Infected Mushroom, resets movement speed
- New power-up: Gold Mushroom, increases the speed boost of red mushrooms
- Hotdog indicator redesigned
- New skill: Explosion, unlocked after finding 5 rockets
- Updated relic: Package Airdrops will appear after 3mins
- New secret relic
- Red Rocket and Explosion now leave fire and smoke

Performance
- Refined chunk loading
- Most of the code has been completely rewritten

UI Changes
- Consistent UI
- New pickup mini-notification window
- New win screen
- New start screen
- New settings screen, feature a hotdog volume slider
- New font and styling
- Added item counters for hotdogs, poop, gold mushrooms, and rockets
- Added an icon and label for the jump ability

Other
- Several new achievements
- Increased tree density
- Changed sprites and slight adjustments to sky and grass colors
- Increased grass view distance
- New wiener dog design
- Red mushroom balanced due to the new power-up 

We hope you enjoy all the new features and improvements in this update. Please report any issues or feature requests in the comments. We assure you that other frequently requested features are being considered for future updates. Happy hunting!

notes.title: New Hand-Drawn UI & Gameplay Tweaks: July Update!
notes.content:
I am thrilled to announce the latest regular update, packed with some features and improvements! Dive into the details below to see what's new:

- Most UI assets have been replaced with hand-drawn art
- Removed rain from Rock Hard mode
- Made Hard mode harder
- Decreased mushroom speed boost slightly
- Increased eggplant wiener dog growth slightly
- Added a small chance for poop to appear in Rock Hard mode

Considering the following in the next major update:
- More aspect ratio support
- Maps
- More relics
- More config settings
- Rework Hotdog flash indicator

I am also hard at work on the mobile release to bring these fantastic improvements to your mobile devices!

notes.title: Major Update: Graphics Overhaul, Game Balancing, New Power-Ups, and a New Relic!
notes.content:
I am thrilled to announce the latest update, packed with exciting new features and improvements! Dive into the details below to see what's new:

- Complete hand drawn (by my lovely wife) graphics overhaul 
- Power-up balancing
- Added a visual indicator to the Hotdog Power-Up to show the direction
- Poops now have a UI pop-up
- An all new relic that disables rain, if you're lucky enough to find it
- Reduced Red Rocket explosion area
- Added cat tails 
- Added butterflies
- Added rocks 
- Added a note in Rock Hard mode about the absence of power-ups
- Enabled lower look sensitivity options
- Animated the wiener
- Steam Deck compatible!


All this is also coming to the mobile version releasing in July!

notes.title: Quality of Life and Balance Changes Update!
notes.content:
I am excited to share some new quality of life (QoL) and balance changes that I have been working on! Your feedback has been invaluable, and I have made several adjustments to enhance your gameplay experience:

Increased poop size slightly.
Increased poop frequency slightly.
Decreased rain volume slightly.
Added volume slider.
Added look sensitivity settings.
Added restart game button.
Implemented small performance gains.
Updated UI for upcoming mobile support.
Added Jamcraft splash screen.

These updates aim to make "Find My Wiener" even more enjoyable and accessible. I appreciate your support and feedback as I continue to improve the game.

Stay tuned for more planned BIG updates, and happy hunting!
